title: Sati Behula
desc: Savitri, a devoted wife, decides to cure her husband, a person with a disability, through her prayers and with the help of Goddess Manasa.

title: Agnipath
desc: Siblings Sujay, Ajay, and Bijay share a strong bond, but Bijay seeks revenge after Sujay is killed by his boss.

title: Pooja
desc: Puja, a servant, decides to take action when her daughter-in-law Moina suffers cruel mistreatment by her in-laws due to dowry demands, setting off a powerful journey for justice and family loyalty.

title: Mejo Bou
desc: The film revolves around a mother-in-law, who treats her daughters-in-laws, Mamta, Tandra and Deepa, according to their husband's income. However, when she falls ill, she realises her folly.

title: Pratisodh
desc: Ranjan is imprisoned as a result of a false allegation levelled against him by Sanatan. Ranjan's father becomes insane due to these developments.

title: Porinaam

title: Parineeta
desc: Mehul falls deeply in love with her tutor, Babai. Her world shatters when she hears about his tragic suicide, leaving her heartbroken and lost.

title: Dekh Kemon Laage
desc: Rahul constantly lands in trouble and his friend Gunja helps him out. But when his father forces him to get married, Gunja refuses to come to his aid.
